derivation_note: DERIVED: reads context.max_claim_amount and writes/reads a globalMap fatal flag that a downstream RUN_IF connection consumes, and calls the custom routine routines.ClaimRoutines.validateClaim (which calls formatClaimCode -- routine-calling-routine). Reasoned through using the Dev context value max_claim_amount=5000.

cases.description: claim well within threshold -> no code

expected_output._note: 1200 <= 5000 and not negative -> validateClaim returns null

cases.description: edge case: claim far exceeds 10x threshold -> FATAL, throws and is caught by Talend die/warn machinery

expected_output._note: 75000 > 5000*10=50000 -> formatClaimCode(claimId,'FATAL_OVER_LIMIT') -> 'CLM2:Fatal Over Limit' (StringUtils.titleCase on 'FATAL OVER LIMIT'.toLowerCase-then-titlecased per titleCase's own logic); globalMap job20_fatalFlag set true; block throws RuntimeException so no output_row is actually emitted for this row -- the claim_code shown here is what the routine call computed before the throw
amount<0 matches the NEGATIVE branch first (checked before the over-threshold branches)

cases.description: claim above threshold but below the 10x fatal cutoff -> REVIEW
Prod context doubles the threshold to 10000

expected_output._note: under Prod context (max_claim_amount=10000) the same 8000 claim that would be REVIEW in Dev/Test is within bounds -> null code
